locator: I q.2 a.3 co., quinta via: sicut sagitta a sagittante
interpretation: The archer directs the arrow by moving it: directing to an end is read as moving in some respect, in the broad prima via sense of motion as reduction from potency to act. The simile is the only textual basis in the article; ST I q.103 (governance as moving things to their end) is not pinned.
